claim_boundary: Within-run object-held-out evaluation on a six-object, provenance-specific Deform360 replication-v1 sampled-hull subset. Object paths and archive bytes are locked before arrays are opened, and source/calibration/target object roles are disjoint. The mounted release and some source outcomes have been used previously in this repository, so this is not fresh independent-data validation. The adapter evaluates endpoint displacement transfer and raw/corrected predictive uncertainty, not the official action-conditioned Deform360 world-model task or Table-4 protocol. A positive registered decision would justify an official-adapter study; it is not by itself an official benchmark or deployment-calibration claim.

guard.score: finite-sample 90th percentile of endpoint disagreement divided by predictive standard deviation
guard.selection: minimize equal-source-group archive-balanced regret subject to no positive source-group regret

uncertainty.calibration_rule: finite-sample higher quantile of calibration-group 90th-percentile adjusted NEES ratios
uncertainty.source_shape: weighted nonnegative log-linear scale in log1p(horizon) fitted to median source-group finite-sample scales
uncertainty.target_use: frozen source shape times frozen calibration multiplier
